Lanternfly Accelerator — Spring 2027 cohort
Lanternfly backs early-stage climate software startups with $150,000 in funding and 12 weeks of mentorship, ending in a demo day.
Who can apply
Open to pre-seed and seed startups from anywhere in the world.
At least one founder must work full-time on the company.
Terms
We invest $150,000 in exchange for 7% equity.
Free to apply.
How to apply
Submit your pitch deck and a 2-minute demo video through our application form.
Applications close March 15, 2027.
